posts.meta_description:
268K likes, 5,019 comments - karljacobs on February 21, 2026: "🦦 Go watch the new MrBeast video! 🦦

Had the AMAZING opportunity to get to visit some amazing communities filled with fantastic people, while working with great people and organizations. All with the 1 goal being to get education more accessible in even the harder to reach places on earth.
I went to Mexico and Ecuador and WOW the natural beauty in both of those places REALLY left an impression on me. Also had a great time traveling with the guys, and meeting my new favorite person ever @ederbez (unironically though he was great. Amazing person to everyone and treated everyone with so much care)

PS: the final pic is me and my coach right after my shutout goalie performance with the classes of students in Mexico 🔥 I still got it 🥱🔥⚽️".

posts.meta_description:
54K likes, 3,052 comments - karljacobs on January 14, 2026: "Wanted to show you guys some pics of me with my best friend :D

Today Beast Games released its cross over episode with Survivor! I couldn’t be more proud of the part I took in this! Survivor has always and always will be a giant part of me, and as something that has fueled a lot of my obsession with creating content, getting to meet the people behind it, and make something cool with them is something I’ll never forget.

I believe it started as @seanklitzner and I going on a promotional adventure for Season 49. But watching how he (and the team ofc) somehow managed to continue the momentum from that to connect them with Beast Games and create what may be the largest cross over in Reality competition history; I’m so lucky and blessed to have gotten the chance to even be a part of it!

CHECK IT OUT IF U HAVE THE CHANCE!".
